headline: Gunman kills one, wounds 4 near Paris in vehicle shooting, terror probe launched
summary: A man opened fire from a vehicle in the towns of Trappes and La Verriere, leading to a murder investigation with a potential terrorist link.
details: A man opened fire from a vehicle yesterday in the towns of Trappes and La Verriere, west of Paris, killing one person and wounding four. Emergency services are still working at the scene, about 20 kilometers west of the French capital.
The suspect was arrested in the nearby town of Coignieres after the shootings occurred around 10:30 am. Prosecutors have launched an investigation into the incident.
The investigation is being treated as a "murder in connection with a terrorist enterprise." Local authorities noted the casualty toll could still change as emergency services continue their work.

Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu described the case as "very serious," stating that all security and judicial resources are fully mobilised. The mayor of Trappes, Ali Rabeh, confirmed the individual fired shots at multiple people along his path.

headline_marked: [[Two killed in Ctg road crash]], bus torched by protesters
headline: Two killed in Ctg road crash, bus torched by protesters
summary: Two passengers died after a bus rammed their autorickshaw on the Chattogram-Cox’s Bazar Highway. The fatal accident sparked immediate protests, leading to the bus being set ablaze and traffic disruption.
details: Two passengers of an autorickshaw were killed after their vehicle was rammed by a bus on the Chattogram-Cox’s Bazar Highway. The tragic incident occurred around 8 PM on Friday in Satkania’s Nayakhal area.
Following the crash, angry protesters blocked the road and set the bus on fire, police reported. This act of protest brought traffic to a complete standstill for approximately an hour and a half.
Nurul Absar, chief of Dohazari Highway Police Station, confirmed that traffic resumed normal movement around 9:30 PM. Police intervened to disperse the protesters and clear the road.

Locals stated that a bus traveling from Satkania’s Keranihat towards Chattogram City veered out of control. It first struck a parked motorcycle before colliding with the autorickshaw, causing severe injuries to its passengers.
